levels.felt_state: The surge overwhelms ordinary self-organization; containment itself can occupy the whole performance.
levels.face: Let the eyes fix beyond easy conversational contact, then return only to a direct address. The brow stays set, mouth hangs on a wordless opening, and a sudden blink or lip tremor breaks the mask.
levels.voice: A single safely voiced phrase can emerge from silence in an unstable or unusually low register. Tone may thin; loudness is optional, pace becomes isolated words, and complete pauses with natural breathing replace any requirement for screaming or breathless endurance.
levels.body: Choose complete stillness, a supported halt or a purposeful exit. Empty hands and rooted weight make withheld action legible; the chest can remain turned toward the offense after the rest of the body begins leaving.
levels.timing: Peak intensity may be a held decision that lasts after the spoken confrontation ends.
levels.restrained_alternative: Say nothing, set the prop down safely, and use a deliberate retreat as the entire response.
levels.recovery: Prioritize space and restored orientation; shame, exhaustion or renewed anger may follow without immediate insight.
levels.playable_direction: Survive the moment without surrendering your final choice.

face.text: Return the fixed eyes only when directly addressed by someone.
Hold the brow set while the face loses ordinary social movement.
Let the mouth open without words before one deliberate response.

voice.text: Use one low or briefly unstable register for the chosen phrase.
Allow a thin easy tone without requiring shouting or vocal force.
Place isolated words within long silences supported by natural breathing.

body.text: Choose complete stillness or a purposeful supported exit from exposure.
Set down the prop and keep empty hands deliberately open.
Root the base until the next controlled action is actually chosen.

variants.label: Released confrontation
variants.context: An acute offense breaks through an existing attempt to remain composed.
variants.objective: Stop the offense through a direct released demand.
variants.face_modifier: Allow one sudden change from held lips to an open demand; do not sustain maximum facial contraction.
variants.voice_modifier: Use short safely projected bursts with comfortable resets, preserving intelligibility and vocal ease.
variants.body_modifier: Give any large movement a stop point and safe distance.
variants.timing_modifier: Contrast the release with the quiet or task that immediately preceded it.

seven_levels.modifier: Let one sharpened word escape before the character deliberately resumes the earlier controlled manner.
Interrupt sooner than intended, then visibly choose the next sentence instead of letting it run on.
Turn fully and release the central demand in one clear burst, followed by silence that expects compliance.
An ignored demand prompts a second, shorter release; eliminate explanation rather than simply adding volume.
Allow the attempted sentence to break into its essential prohibition, then stop moving while it lands.
After the strongest release, become unexpectedly still; the unresolved offense remains present in the fixed attention.
Let the peak end speech or trigger a deliberate exit; there is no requirement for sustained screaming or physical destruction.

variants.label: Contained rage
variants.context: Consequences, values or power make outward discharge unacceptable despite a consuming surge.
variants.objective: Withhold the action the feeling is urging while preserving a necessary boundary.
variants.face_modifier: Use fixed attention, minimal lip movement and delayed blinking rather than a compulsory glare.
variants.voice_modifier: Keep ordinary or low volume; let preparation, separated words and exact endings expose control effort.
variants.body_modifier: Reduce movement and put objects down before they become part of an impulse.
variants.timing_modifier: Let every silence contain an active decision.

seven_levels.modifier: Maintain the expected social response while one brief stillness interrupts the body’s ordinary ease.
Finish a courtesy phrase, then pause longer than convention allows before continuing.
State the boundary quietly and keep the hands open, making compliance with your own restraint visible.
Choose each word after hearing the provocation in full; the lack of interruption becomes effortful.
Set down the prop and anchor the body before answering, refusing to let the surge choose your movements.
Reduce conversation to the one condition you can still state accurately; hold silence through attempted distractions.
Choose departure or complete silence as the last available controlled action; overwhelming feeling can remain almost invisible to strangers.

temporal_arc.onset: An offense is appraised as intolerable, sometimes after accumulated anger.
temporal_arc.escalation: Repeated provocation narrows attention and reduces available response options.
temporal_arc.apex: Release, immobility or chosen withdrawal can each carry the consuming peak.
temporal_arc.recovery: Distance and a clear end to the immediate offense allow orientation and choice to return.
temporal_arc.carryover: Aftereffects may include fatigue, trembling, renewed anger or remorse, depending on what actually occurred.

transitions.trigger: The character recognizes harm caused during the surge.
transitions.bridge: Attention drops from the original target to the injured person; a demand becomes a specific acknowledgment.

transitions.trigger: The surge passes without resolving the underlying conflict.
transitions.bridge: Release the fixed posture, let speech lose urgency, and make the next practical movement costly.

transitions.trigger: The character converts the surge into a bounded plan.
transitions.bridge: Widen attention to the next controllable step, place the hands deliberately, and state a concrete objective.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Set the held object down safely, fix on the other person, and stop a forward movement before speaking.
prompt_example.delivery_direction: Give the line in a low exact register after a long pause, allowing one break in contour on “here.”

cue_conflicts: A released outburst and total containment are selectable display strategies; do not prescribe simultaneous shouting and inaudibility.
Rage does not require violence, threatening proximity or prop destruction.
Facial immobility may intensify while actual vocal volume falls.
emotions.context_notes: Build from the character’s values, inhibition and learned conflict style. Relationship, power and cultural display rules shape what can be released. Keep movements safe, choose accessible equivalents for any approach or retreat, and never force vocal strain.

emotions.label: Indignation
emotions.definition: Anger organized around a perceived violation of fairness, dignity or a shared moral standard; the character experiences the objection as warranted, though the judgment can be mistaken.
emotions.appraisal: This violates a standard that should protect people, and letting it pass would endorse it.
emotions.objective: Expose the violation, restore the standard and secure recognition or corrective action.
action_tendencies: Defend an affected person or principle
distinctions: Anger can defend a personal preference; indignation invokes a standard beyond immediate annoyance.
Contempt devalues the offender; indignation can still demand that they meet the standard.
Moral outrage is an alias here, not a second canonical emotion.

face.brows_forehead: Brows can lift at disbelief, then draw together around the judgment.
face.eyelids: Eyes open to verify the breach before lower lids firm.
face.gaze: Look between offender, affected person and witnesses according to the objective.
face.blink: A blink can punctuate recognition that the violation was deliberate.
face.cheeks: Cheeks tense when the character withholds a sharper accusation.
face.nose_nostrils: Nose stays ordinary or lifts slightly with rejecting disbelief.
face.lips_mouth: Lips part at the breach, then form a clear, complete objection.
face.jaw_chin: Chin can rise to refuse diminishment; jaw releases for formal articulation.
face.head_neck: Head comes upright as the character claims the right to object.
face.complexion: No required flush; visibility follows character baseline and lighting.

voice.pitch_register: A clear middle register can rise on disbelief and settle on principle.
voice.pitch_range_contour: Use a questioning ascent followed by a firm declarative descent.
voice.loudness: Projection may address witnesses, but private indignation can remain quiet.
voice.tempo_rhythm: Speech often organizes around complete claims and their evidence.
voice.stress: Stress the breached standard, affected person or unequal comparison.
voice.articulation: Distinct wording can make the objection accountable and quotable.
voice.resonance: A present, open resonance can support a public statement without shouting.
voice.texture: Tone may be incredulous, severe or restrainedly formal.
voice.breath_phrasing: Separate the evidence and demand with comfortable breath groups.
voice.pauses: Pause after naming the standard to let others register its relevance.
voice.nonverbal_vocalizations: A short incredulous laugh or exhale is optional and can cease abruptly.

body.head_neck: Head lifts from the immediate task toward the moral confrontation.
body.shoulders: Shoulders settle into a posture that can sustain being seen.
body.chest_torso: Chest faces the room or the accountable person.
body.arms_elbows: An arm may indicate the affected person without claiming them as a prop.
body.hands_fingers: An open palm can present evidence or refuse complicity.
body.pelvis_weight: Weight grounds beneath the body as the character takes a position.
body.legs_feet: Feet remain oriented toward the exchange or a chosen refusal to participate.
body.gait: A deliberate step forward can claim a hearing; stillness can do the same.
body.proxemics: Distance may protect the harmed person or preserve a formal challenge.
body.touch_props: Place evidence where others can inspect it; avoid compulsory pointing.
body.stillness: A held upright posture can sustain the objection after speech ends.

levels.label: Trace
levels.felt_state: A small inconsistency touches a shared standard.
levels.face: One brow lifts as the eyes check the unequal treatment. The mouth parts slightly, then closes into a considering line; the chin turns toward whoever could explain the discrepancy.
levels.voice: Use habitual register with a small questioning rise and a mildly incredulous tone. Keep volume conversational and pace measured; stress the unequal detail, pause for a possible explanation, and breathe easily before turning the observation into a claim.
levels.body: Stop the current task and angle the torso toward the exchange. One hand remains near the evidence while weight stays neutral; the body offers an opening for correction rather than a confrontation.
levels.timing: Let verification precede judgment; the discrepancy may still have an innocent explanation.
levels.restrained_alternative: Ask the factual question with a neutral face and unusually precise wording.
levels.recovery: A credible explanation restores ease without requiring an apology.
levels.playable_direction: Check whether the same rule is actually being applied.

face.text: Check the unequal treatment before looking toward its possible explanation.
Lift one brow at the apparent inconsistency in the shared rule.
Part the lips briefly, then close them into consideration.

voice.text: Use habitual register with a small verifying upward question.
Keep a mildly incredulous tone at ordinary conversational volume.
Stress the unequal detail and leave an easily breathed explanatory pause.

body.text: Angle the torso toward the exchange while leaving room for correction.
Keep one hand near the concrete evidence of unequal treatment.
Hold neutral weight while the discrepancy is still being verified.

levels.label: Mild
levels.felt_state: The unfairness appears real enough to question openly.
levels.face: Lift both inner brows briefly, then narrow the eyes at the explanation. Lips press before a clear question; the jaw remains loose while the head comes into a more upright alignment.
levels.voice: Begin in a slightly raised middle register and end with a controlled fall. Tone becomes dry and skeptical at normal volume; remove conversational padding, articulate the comparison, and leave a patient pause with an ordinary breath.
levels.body: Turn the chest fully toward the accountable person. Present a small open palm toward the relevant fact, then lower it; settle the pelvis and let the feet stop drifting toward the former task.
levels.timing: The shift follows confirmation, not merely dislike of the person involved.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep a courteous smile while making the unequal comparison impossible to evade.
levels.recovery: Acknowledging the inconsistency can soften the gaze before the posture relaxes.
levels.playable_direction: Get them to hear the mismatch in their own rule.

face.text: Look skeptically at the explanation after checking the unequal detail.
Lift the brows briefly, then gather them around the question.
Press the lips before making the comparison clearly audible.

voice.text: Begin slightly higher and finish with a controlled downward contour.
Let the tone dry while keeping the volume conversational.
Remove padding, articulate the comparison and wait with ordinary breath.

body.text: Turn the chest fully toward whoever can account for the difference.
Present the relevant fact with a small, lowered open palm.
Settle the base instead of drifting back toward the former task.

levels.label: Clear
levels.felt_state: A clear violation requires the character to take a position.
levels.face: Brows draw together after a brief disbelief lift. Gaze alternates once between the affected person and decision-maker, then holds; the lips open cleanly into the objection rather than a sneer.
levels.voice: Use a grounded register and a rising statement of evidence followed by a falling principle. Tone is clear and firm, volume audible to the intended listeners; slow the central comparison, pause after it, and replenish breath comfortably.
levels.body: Square the torso to the exchange without blocking anyone’s exit. Place evidence in view, let one hand remain open, and establish a stable standing or seated base that can sustain the hearing.
levels.timing: Place the moral claim after the concrete evidence so it carries a specific consequence.
levels.restrained_alternative: Stay seated and state the principle with the same measured tone used for ordinary facts.
levels.recovery: An honest acknowledgment permits listening while the demand for correction remains.
levels.playable_direction: Make the room recognize what its decision is doing.

face.text: Look once toward the affected person, then hold the decision-maker.
Draw the brows together after the initial lift of disbelief.
Open the lips cleanly for an objection without adding a sneer.

voice.text: Use a grounded register with a rising fact and falling principle.
Keep the tone clear and firm at an appropriately audible volume.
Slow the central comparison and leave a full, breathed pause.

body.text: Square the torso to claim a hearing without blocking movement.
Place the evidence where others can inspect the actual claim.
Establish a stable base that can sustain the public objection.

levels.label: Strong
levels.felt_state: Dismissal makes silence feel like complicity.
levels.face: Eyes widen at the dismissal, then fix under a firmer brow. The upper lip separates for an interrupted objection; cheeks tighten as the character deliberately reforms the sentence into a complete claim.
levels.voice: A quick higher interruption settles into a more formal middle register. Tone is severe but supported, volume firm; speed the correction of the evasion, slow the named standard, and hold a substantial pause before an easy next breath.
levels.body: Lean toward the exchange from a stable base, then become upright. An open hand interrupts the procedure; the other stays near the evidence, while arms avoid turning the objection into personal intimidation.
levels.timing: Escalate at the moment the harm is minimized or the witness is silenced.
levels.restrained_alternative: Remove the social smile and use a quiet procedural refusal that stops the next step.
levels.recovery: A reopened hearing restores some flexibility; the body may remain ready to object again.
levels.playable_direction: Refuse to help the room pretend it did not understand.

face.text: Fix the gaze after the dismissal has briefly widened the eyes.
Hold the brow firm when silence would imply acceptance.
Interrupt at the lips, then reform the response into a complete claim.

voice.text: Let the quick higher interruption settle into a formal middle register.
Use a severe supported tone at firm or controlled volume.
Slow the named standard and hold a substantial breathed pause.

body.text: Lean toward the exchange, then return to an upright position.
Interrupt the procedure with one open hand beside the evidence.
Keep weight grounded while the objection acquires a practical cost.

levels.label: Intense
levels.felt_state: The violation threatens a defining value and demands costly opposition.
levels.face: Hold the eyes steadily on the decision-maker, with brief checking looks to the affected person. Brows remain compressed, lips tremble once before firming, and the chin stays level instead of rising into superiority.
levels.voice: Keep a grounded register with wide emphasis on the principle and narrow endings on consequences. Tone may be strained in feeling but vocally easy; choose strong or quiet volume, deliberate pace, long accountability pauses and comfortable breath resets.
levels.body: Move to a position that makes refusal visible, or stay seated when standing would concede the setting. Hands become spare; chest and pelvis align with the chosen stand, and feet cease preparing a polite escape.
levels.timing: The practical cost of speaking becomes visible just before the character speaks anyway.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use a low formal sentence that records dissent while the rest of the body remains still.
levels.recovery: A concrete remedy allows the stance to loosen; mere reassurance may leave it intact.
levels.playable_direction: Stand by the standard when it starts costing you.

face.text: Hold the decision-maker while briefly checking the affected person's response.
Maintain the compressed brow without letting the chin imply superiority.
Allow one lip tremor before forming the precise costly commitment.

voice.text: Use grounded pitch with wider principle emphasis and narrow consequential endings.
Let the tone remain supported whether projected strongly or quietly contained.
Speak deliberately and leave long pauses for accountable responses and breaths.

body.text: Orient the torso toward the chosen stand rather than an easy escape.
Reduce hand gestures so the evidence and refusal remain central.
Settle the base into the position whose cost you accept.

levels.label: Consuming
levels.felt_state: The injustice monopolizes attention and demands sustained intervention.
levels.face: The gaze returns to the harmed person after every evasion, then back to the responsible party. Forehead tension stays fixed; the mouth loses social shaping and moves only for essential, carefully formed words.
levels.voice: Use a narrow, resolute register punctuated by sharper rises when facts are distorted. Tone is austere at chosen volume; repeat the unresolved demand slowly, allow silence after each refusal, and take ordinary breaths before replacing another diversion with the principle.
levels.body: Hold position through invitations to move on. The torso follows the unresolved exchange, arms stay economical, and hands guard the evidence or rest open; the planted base makes continued presence part of the objection.
levels.timing: Repetition is driven by nonresponse, with increasing space around the same unresolved point.
levels.restrained_alternative: Let silence and a refusal to participate carry the objection after one concise statement.
levels.recovery: Actual procedural change restores forward motion; attention may stay with those affected.
levels.playable_direction: Keep the harmed person or principle from being edited out.

face.text: Return the gaze to the affected person after each diversion.
Keep a fixed forehead tension while the objection remains unanswered.
Move the lips only for essential and carefully formed words.

voice.text: Use narrow resolute pitch with sharper rises against factual distortion.
Keep an austere tone at the volume the setting requires.
Repeat the unresolved demand slowly with genuine, comfortably breathed waiting gaps.

body.text: Maintain torso orientation through invitations to abandon the unresolved exchange.
Rest the hands openly or keep the evidence steadily available.
Hold the base so continued presence becomes part of the objection.

levels.label: Overwhelming
levels.felt_state: The breach overwhelms the character’s ability to continue ordinary participation.
levels.face: An unblinking look may give way to lowered eyes toward the evidence. Brows hold their crease, the mouth opens without the expected argument, and the chin resets before a final refusal or stunned silence.
levels.voice: A low, clear line or one safely projected declaration can replace extended argument. Register may briefly break; tone thins, pace becomes sparse, and long pauses with natural breaths make the final statement consequential without requiring a shouted moral speech.
levels.body: Stop participating in the procedure. Set down the pen or badge, stand aside or root the seated body, and open the hands away from the disputed act; withdrawal of cooperation becomes the largest available movement.
levels.timing: The peak can arrive after all reasonable objections have been heard and ignored.
levels.restrained_alternative: Make one quiet refusal and remain present to its consequences without further display.
levels.recovery: Recovery depends on space, solidarity or real change; the moral judgment need not soften immediately.
levels.playable_direction: Choose what you will not help happen.

face.text: Look from the decision-maker down to the decisive evidence.
Keep the brow creased as further argument becomes temporarily unavailable.
Open without the expected speech, then form one final refusal.

voice.text: Use a low clear line or one safely projected declaration.
Let the tone thin while avoiding pressure to perform moral anguish.
Reduce speech to sparse words with long, naturally breathed pauses.

body.text: Stop participating in the procedure that now requires a refusal.
Set down the pen or token that would authorize participation.
Root or reposition the base to make withdrawal of cooperation clear.

variants.label: Unfair treatment of the self
variants.context: A rule or expectation is applied unjustly to the character.
variants.objective: Claim equal treatment without losing the shared standard.
variants.face_modifier: Check the comparison before meeting the decision-maker’s gaze.
variants.voice_modifier: Stress equality of treatment rather than an unbounded claim of personal superiority.
variants.body_modifier: Use evidence or the actual procedure to ground the claim.
variants.timing_modifier: Let the comparison sharpen with each attempted exception.

seven_levels.modifier: Notice the exception made for someone else and ask one low-key factual question about it.
Repeat the stated rule, then wait for an explanation of why your case is treated differently.
Place both cases side by side with one clear gesture and ask for consistent treatment.
After dismissal, stop defending your likability and return to the relevant criterion with a firmer voice.
Accept the social cost of the objection while keeping the requested remedy proportionate and concrete.
Refuse a special favor that leaves the unfair rule intact, if that is the character’s chosen value.
Withdraw cooperation or make a final formal objection; the strongest beat can be quiet ownership of the cost.

variants.label: Witnessed injustice
variants.context: The character observes a violation affecting another person or group in the scene.
variants.objective: Secure a hearing or protection without replacing the affected person’s agency.
variants.face_modifier: Look to the affected person for cues before addressing the responsible party.
variants.voice_modifier: Name the act precisely; leave room for the affected person to speak.
variants.body_modifier: Create space or stop a procedure without automatically touching or physically shielding someone.
variants.timing_modifier: Escalate when dismissal compounds the original violation.

seven_levels.modifier: Look from the unequal treatment to the affected person, checking whether intervention would be useful.
Ask the clarifying question that the room is avoiding, keeping the affected person within conversational attention.
Name the unfair act and hand the conversational space back to the person whose account matters.
Interrupt a dismissal, then hold a pause long enough for the silenced person to continue.
Put your own status or convenience at stake by refusing to endorse the ongoing violation.
Keep the unresolved harm central through repeated diversions, avoiding a performance of your own virtue.
Withdraw cooperation or demand an immediate stop while preserving the affected person’s choices about what comes next.

temporal_arc.onset: An apparent inconsistency prompts verification against a valued standard.
temporal_arc.escalation: Evidence and dismissal transform concern into a principled objection.
temporal_arc.apex: A demand, refusal or visible stand exposes the cost of the violation.
temporal_arc.recovery: Acknowledgment and remedy reopen participation; agreement alone may be insufficient.
temporal_arc.carryover: The character may carry vigilance, solidarity or changed trust into later scenes.

transitions.trigger: The dispute becomes focused on a personal boundary or offender.
transitions.bridge: Narrow the public claim to a direct demand addressed to the responsible person.

transitions.trigger: The character identifies a concrete corrective campaign or next step.
transitions.bridge: Move the gaze from outrage-provoking evidence to a plan and assign the hands a practical task.

transitions.trigger: Repeated refusal becomes evidence that the offender is beneath respect.
transitions.bridge: Stop offering explanations; let direct engagement give way to a distancing appraisal.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Look from the vacant place to the person responsible, straighten, and hold the evidence in view.
prompt_example.delivery_direction: Use an incredulous rise on “thought,” then a firm fall; leave a pause that asks for accountability.

cue_conflicts: Public projection and private formal quiet are equally available; moral intensity does not prescribe volume.
A lifted chin can claim standing or imply superiority; choose according to the objective.
The character’s certainty does not establish that their moral judgment is correct.
emotions.context_notes: Ground the judgment in the character’s actual standard and the scene’s facts. Power, relationship and cultural rules affect how dissent is expressed. Accessible stillness, gaze or withdrawal of a signature can replace standing or stepping forward.

emotions.label: Resentment
emotions.definition: A sustained grievance in which a remembered wrong, unequal burden or denied acknowledgment remains emotionally active and shapes present interpretation.
emotions.appraisal: What happened has not been properly recognized or repaired, and I am still carrying the cost.
emotions.objective: Make the unpaid grievance count, obtain acknowledgment or protect against another unequal demand.
distinctions: Anger can address a present breach; resentment carries an unresolved ledger across time.
Hate rejects the target more globally; resentment may soften with credible acknowledgment and repair.
Envy centers on another’s advantage, while resentment appraises an unfair cost or wrong.

face.brows_forehead: Brows may settle into an uneven, skeptical configuration at familiar requests.
face.eyelids: Lower lids tighten while the social upper face remains composed.
face.gaze: Gaze revisits the beneficiary, evidence or reminder of the old imbalance.
face.blink: A delayed blink can replace an overt response to an old pattern.
face.cheeks: One cheek may tighten beneath a maintained social expression.
face.nose_nostrils: Nose movement is optional; use an ordinary exhale rather than disgust shorthand.
face.lips_mouth: A closed smile can arrive late and leave early.
face.jaw_chin: Jaw shifts once at the familiar phrase; chin may angle away.
face.head_neck: Head turns only partway toward someone asking for more.
face.complexion: Maintain baseline complexion unless the scene supplies visible variation.

voice.pitch_register: A contained middle or low register can contrast with outwardly acceptable wording.
voice.pitch_range_contour: Contours flatten on cooperation and rise on pointed comparisons.
voice.loudness: Often moderate or quiet; audience and power determine projection.
voice.tempo_rhythm: Delayed starts and exact accounting interrupt otherwise normal rhythm.
voice.stress: Stress small possessives, dates or repeated obligations when they matter.
voice.articulation: Polite wording can become unusually exact and stripped of softeners.
voice.resonance: A dry resonance can replace the character’s usual relational warmth.
voice.texture: Tone may be cool, wounded, bitter or formally cooperative.
voice.breath_phrasing: Keep phrases supported; a small exhale may precede a reluctant agreement.
voice.pauses: Pause where acknowledgment should have occurred.
voice.nonverbal_vocalizations: A humorless chuckle or short nasal exhale can expose the old grievance.

body.head_neck: Head orientation may lag behind an expected greeting or request.
body.shoulders: Shoulders remain turned toward the character’s own task.
body.chest_torso: Torso offers less participation than the spoken agreement implies.
body.arms_elbows: Elbows stay close and gestures become transactional.
body.hands_fingers: Hands complete the minimum exchange without the usual extra help.
body.pelvis_weight: Weight remains ready to disengage rather than joining the interaction fully.
body.legs_feet: Feet can keep their original direction through a nominally friendly exchange.
body.gait: Movement may be dutiful and exact, with warmth removed rather than speed increased.
body.proxemics: Maintain a social distance that used to be smaller.
body.touch_props: Return a borrowed item carefully; withhold an optional gesture of care.
body.stillness: A held pause can make the missing acknowledgment palpable.

levels.label: Trace
levels.felt_state: An old imbalance briefly colors an otherwise ordinary moment.
levels.face: A familiar request draws a side look and a tiny lower-lid tightening. The mouth starts its usual smile a fraction late; the chin stays angled toward the character’s own unfinished task.
levels.voice: Use the habitual register with a slightly flatter ending. Tone loses a trace of warmth at normal volume; delay the first word, keep the pace ordinary afterward, and take a small comfortable breath before resuming the task.
levels.body: Complete the requested handoff but omit the extra helpful movement. Keep the torso partly on the original task, elbows close, and weight unchanged; the withheld fraction is more informative than a large gesture.
levels.timing: Let the reminder briefly interrupt an established pattern of warmth or ease.
levels.restrained_alternative: Give the usual answer and reveal the grievance only in the delayed return of gaze.
levels.recovery: Attention can move on, though the ledger remains available for another reminder.
levels.playable_direction: Remember the cost without deciding to raise it yet.

face.text: Give the familiar request a brief, delayed side look.
Let the brow change only after the old pattern registers.
Allow the usual smile to arrive a fraction too late.

voice.text: Use the habitual register with a subtly flattened ending.
Remove a trace of warmth while keeping ordinary volume.
Delay the first word, then resume with a comfortable breath.

body.text: Keep the torso partly committed to your own unfinished task.
Complete the handoff while omitting the usual extra helpful movement.
Keep weight where it was instead of fully joining the request.

levels.label: Mild
levels.felt_state: The current request resembles the unresolved unfair pattern.
levels.face: Brows draw unevenly as gaze checks who is benefiting again. Lips form a small closed smile that does not reach the cheeks; the jaw shifts once before a carefully neutral answer.
levels.voice: Stay in a low-middle register with a small rise on the pointed detail. Tone is dry at conversational volume; pace remains measured, stress the repeated obligation, and place a short pause before an easy breath and nominal agreement.
levels.body: Turn the head but not the whole chest. Let the offered hand stop at a practical distance, keep the other hand on the character’s own work, and retain a base oriented toward disengagement.
levels.timing: The pointed detail lands as recognition of a pattern, not a new surprise.
levels.restrained_alternative: Answer warmly enough for an observer while reducing all optional assistance.
levels.recovery: A spontaneous acknowledgment can soften the mouth; generic thanks may leave the pattern unchanged.
levels.playable_direction: Make them notice who is being asked again.

face.text: Check who benefits again before answering the familiar request.
Draw the brows unevenly around the recognized pattern of imbalance.
Hold a small closed smile that leaves the cheeks tense.

voice.text: Use low-middle pitch with a slight rise on the pointed detail.
Make the tone dry while keeping the exchange conversationally audible.
Slow the repeated obligation and pause before a reluctant agreement.

body.text: Turn the head while withholding full participation of the chest.
Stop the offered hand at the practical limit of the exchange.
Retain a base oriented toward disengagement rather than automatic joining.

levels.label: Clear
levels.felt_state: The unresolved grievance actively shapes the present exchange.
levels.face: Hold a skeptical look under a low brow, then glance toward the reminder of the earlier wrong. The lips thin after a polite phrase; cheek tension stays while the eyes return for a response.
levels.voice: Use a level lower register and a precise upward hook on the comparison. Tone carries cool hurt, volume modest; slow the relevant date or promise, pause where acknowledgment belongs, and breathe comfortably before answering the new request.
levels.body: Set the shared object down between the participants. Face the exchange more fully without approaching, keep the arms economical, and settle the pelvis as though preparing to wait until the old issue is counted.
levels.timing: Connect the present request to one concrete previous cost.
levels.restrained_alternative: Offer factual accounting in an even voice without an accusation in the wording.
levels.recovery: Specific ownership opens the possibility of cooperation before affection returns.
levels.playable_direction: Get the missing debt into the present conversation.

face.text: Look from the beneficiary to the reminder of the earlier wrong.
Hold a skeptical lowered brow while awaiting missing acknowledgment.
Thin the lips after the polite phrase has been delivered.

voice.text: Use level lower pitch with an upward hook on the comparison.
Let cool hurt color the tone without raising the volume.
Slow the relevant promise and breathe through the acknowledgment pause.

body.text: Face the exchange enough to keep the old issue present.
Set the shared object between you instead of completing automatic service.
Settle the pelvis as though prepared to wait for recognition.

levels.label: Strong
levels.felt_state: Another repetition confirms that the grievance has been ignored.
levels.face: The social smile disappears earlier than expected. Brows knit, eyes remain on the beneficiary, and the lower lip pulls inward before a more direct reference to the old wrong; the chin lifts to sustain it.
levels.voice: Begin with familiar polite cadence, then let it flatten into a lower register. Tone turns bitter or severe at controlled volume; slow the comparison, separate each fact, and leave a substantial pause with an ordinary breath after the unanswered claim.
levels.body: Withdraw the hand that would usually volunteer help. Square the torso enough to be heard, keep feet planted, and place the prop down with deliberate care; participation becomes conditional rather than reflexive.
levels.timing: A familiar cue triggers the old grievance faster than the current event alone would explain.
levels.restrained_alternative: Remain cooperative in essentials while openly declining the extra burden once taken for granted.
levels.recovery: Repair must address the repeated pattern; a pleasant distraction may not reach the grievance.
levels.playable_direction: Stop making your unpaid part invisible.

face.text: Keep the eyes on the beneficiary when the pattern repeats.
Knit the brows when another ignored cost becomes undeniable.
Let the social smile disappear before the expected moment.

voice.text: Flatten familiar polite cadence into a lower, more exact register.
Use bitter or severe color at a deliberately controlled volume.
Separate the facts and leave a substantial, comfortably breathed waiting gap.

body.text: Square the torso enough to make the withdrawn cooperation visible.
Retract the hand that would normally volunteer the extra help.
Plant the base before making participation conditional rather than automatic.

levels.label: Intense
levels.felt_state: The ledger intrudes on unrelated moments and erodes goodwill.
levels.face: Gaze keeps returning to signs that others have moved on. The forehead holds a small fixed crease, lips press around an almost-spoken correction, and the jaw resets after a smile that arrives for everyone else.
levels.voice: Use a narrow lower register with isolated sharp rises at unfair comparisons. Tone is cold or wounded, volume quiet to moderate; speech becomes exact and slower, pauses expose withheld goodwill, and comfortable breaths prevent bitterness from becoming vocal constriction.
levels.body: Keep a deliberate margin of space during shared activity. Arms stay close, hands perform only agreed tasks, and torso and feet reorient toward personal work as soon as each exchange ends.
levels.timing: Let the grievance contaminate a new neutral request, then show the character noticing that spillover.
levels.restrained_alternative: Maintain social competence while withdrawing every unrequired sign of trust or care.
levels.recovery: A frank conversation may release some vigilance; renewed warmth requires evidence over time.
levels.playable_direction: Protect yourself from paying the same cost again.

face.text: Return the eyes to signs that others have moved on.
Hold a small fixed crease as goodwill becomes harder to offer.
Press the lips around a correction you nearly speak.

voice.text: Keep lower pitch narrow, allowing isolated rises at unfair comparisons.
Use a cold or wounded tone at quiet to moderate volume.
Slow the exact account and let pauses expose withheld warmth.

body.text: Preserve a deliberate bodily margin during the shared practical activity.
Use the hands only for the tasks actually agreed.
Reorient the base toward personal work as soon as each exchange ends.

levels.label: Consuming
levels.felt_state: Unacknowledged injury becomes a dominant lens on the relationship.
levels.face: The eyes study small advantages given to the other person, then settle into a tired fixed look. Mouth corners barely move during social language; the cheek and jaw hold tension after the exchange ends.
levels.voice: A low, nearly flat register can carry a meticulous account. Tone is desiccated or deeply hurt at restrained volume; pace alternates exact lists with long gaps, breath groups stay short and easy, and unanswered pauses outweigh emphatic words.
levels.body: Remain at the edge of shared space or hold a formal seated posture. Hands stop anticipating needs, the torso follows only direct obligations, and feet or chair angle preserve a clear option to disengage.
levels.timing: Accumulated examples surface without the current trigger needing to be large.
levels.restrained_alternative: Reduce interaction to necessary logistics while one delayed look keeps the unresolved injury alive.
levels.recovery: Credible restitution and repeated changed behavior may be needed before the defensive distance loosens.
levels.playable_direction: Make the relationship confront the history it keeps skipping.

face.text: Study the other's small advantages before settling into a tired look.
Keep the brow quietly tense after the immediate exchange ends.
Limit mouth movement during language that remains outwardly social.

voice.text: Use a low nearly flat register for the detailed account.
Choose a dry or deeply hurt tone at restrained volume.
Alternate exact details with long gaps and short comfortable breath groups.

body.text: Stay at the edge of shared space without fully disappearing.
Stop anticipating needs that have previously gone unacknowledged or unpaid.
Preserve a clear base from which disengagement remains your choice.

levels.label: Overwhelming
levels.felt_state: The grievance saturates the relationship and makes ordinary generosity temporarily unavailable.
levels.face: Hold a composed face that no longer offers automatic recognition. Gaze meets the other person only at essential moments; brows stay faintly drawn, lips part for a withheld reply, and the chin turns away decisively.
levels.voice: Use sparse phrases in a low or ordinary register with almost level endings. Tone can be emptied rather than explosive, volume minimal; pace slows around each commitment, long pauses replace argument, and ordinary breaths mark the effort to remain civil.
levels.body: Stop volunteering presence as well as help. Put the shared object down, draw the arms into personal space, and turn the whole base away or remain immovably seated; the chosen distance becomes the message.
levels.timing: The peak can be the failure of a familiar appeal to produce any response.
levels.restrained_alternative: State the practical terms of continued contact quietly, without replaying the entire history aloud.
levels.recovery: Rest may reduce saturation; genuine recovery requires addressing the grievance or consciously releasing its claim.
levels.playable_direction: Reach the limit of pretending the account is settled.

face.text: Meet the other person's eyes only when the exchange requires it.
Keep the faint brow crease beneath a deliberately composed face.
Part the lips for a reply, then withhold optional engagement.

voice.text: Use sparse lower or ordinary pitch with almost level endings.
Let the tone become emptied while keeping necessary words audible.
Slow each commitment and let long, natural pauses replace argument.

body.text: Turn the torso away from another appeal for automatic generosity.
Set the shared object down and reclaim personal working space.
Commit the whole base to distance or an immovable formal position.

variants.label: Unequal burden
variants.context: A recurring allocation of work, care or sacrifice leaves the character carrying more.
variants.objective: Make contribution visible and renegotiate the distribution.
variants.face_modifier: Track who receives ease and who remains with the work.
variants.voice_modifier: Emphasize concrete tasks and repeated allocations, keeping the grievance legible.
variants.body_modifier: Let the missing voluntary help distinguish this exchange from earlier ones.
variants.timing_modifier: Tie reminders to actual repeated assignments.

seven_levels.modifier: Notice the familiar assignment and pause before automatically taking it on again.
Ask who is handling the other part, watching whether the question is treated as reasonable.
Name your completed share before accepting another task; let the accounting remain calm and exact.
Decline one extra duty and hold the silence that follows instead of filling it with an apology.
Bring the pattern into view with specific examples, resisting the temptation to make every grievance relevant.
Stop anticipating everyone’s needs; complete agreed obligations while waiting for a genuinely different arrangement.
Withdraw from the unequal arrangement or state firm terms for staying; intense resentment can look like administrative precision.

variants.label: Unacknowledged injury
variants.context: A past hurt remains unowned while the other person expects restored closeness.
variants.objective: Obtain recognition of the injury before resuming the old intimacy.
variants.face_modifier: Let offers of easy warmth meet a brief delayed look rather than an instant smile.
variants.voice_modifier: Keep the missing acknowledgment audible in pauses before familiar relational language.
variants.body_modifier: Allow practical cooperation while optional closeness remains withheld.
variants.timing_modifier: Escalate when the other person treats time alone as repair.

seven_levels.modifier: Allow a friendly gesture to remind you of the unfinished injury, then continue with a slightly delayed response.
Accept ordinary conversation but let a familiar endearment or joke fail to receive its old warmth.
Refer once to what remains unresolved before following the invitation to behave normally.
After minimization, stop cushioning the account of the injury and wait for direct acknowledgment.
Refuse symbolic closeness that would imply resolution; keep the practical request for repair specific.
Let repeated appeals to forget increase distance, while any genuine ownership briefly reopens attention.
State that the old closeness cannot resume under current terms, or quietly end the exchange when words no longer help.

temporal_arc.onset: A reminder activates an injury or imbalance that never felt settled.
temporal_arc.escalation: Repetition and missing acknowledgment make the past increasingly present.
temporal_arc.apex: Withheld cooperation, explicit accounting or relational withdrawal exposes the accumulated cost.
temporal_arc.recovery: Ownership, restitution and changed behavior can gradually reduce the need to keep score.
temporal_arc.carryover: Even after repair, familiar requests may briefly reactivate the old expectation.

transitions.trigger: The old pattern is repeated openly in the present.
transitions.bridge: Turn the indirect comparison into a direct boundary and face the responsible person fully.

transitions.trigger: Credible ownership and repair allow release of the ongoing claim.
transitions.bridge: Let the gaze stop checking the ledger; offer one voluntary act without pretending the history vanished.

transitions.trigger: The grievance becomes a global wish to exclude or oppose the person.
transitions.bridge: Specific accounting gives way to a fixed judgment of the whole target and stronger relational distance.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Complete only the necessary handoff, then let the expected smile arrive late and fade quickly.
prompt_example.delivery_direction: Use a low, dry register; weight “you” lightly and leave a pause where an old promise should be acknowledged.

cue_conflicts: A bitter remark and impeccable formal courtesy can express the same grievance through different restraint choices.
Withholding warmth is distinct from withholding essential care; select behavior appropriate to the actual scene.
Resentment may be justified, mistaken or mixed; the profile does not settle the history.
emotions.context_notes: Anchor the ledger in specific events rather than a stock grudge posture. Relationship, power and cultural obligations shape what can be renegotiated. A small delayed handoff, gaze or pause can carry the state without requiring movement across space.

emotions.label: Contempt
emotions.definition: A devaluing stance in which a person, action or institution is judged beneath respect, often reducing the felt need to persuade, engage or recognize equal standing.
emotions.appraisal: This does not deserve the seriousness or regard it is asking from me.
emotions.objective: Withhold esteem, establish distance or puncture a claim to status.
action_tendencies: Exclude the target from serious consideration
distinctions: Anger asks the target to change; contempt can decide they are not worth the effort.
Disgust rejects contact or intake; contempt centers on social or moral devaluation.
Pride evaluates the self positively and does not require another person’s degradation.

face.brows_forehead: A brow can lift asymmetrically or remain impassively high.
face.eyelids: Upper lids may lower in an assessing, unhurried look.
face.gaze: Look over the claim, then away before the target expects release.
face.blink: An unhurried blink can deny urgency rather than signal fatigue.
face.cheeks: One cheek can lift with a restrained unilateral smile.
face.nose_nostrils: A slight nose lift is optional; avoid making disgust mandatory.
face.lips_mouth: One mouth corner may rise or the lips may flatten into dismissal.
face.jaw_chin: Chin can tip upward or angle aside, depending on status and restraint.
face.head_neck: Head tilts as though evaluating a claim that has already failed.
face.complexion: No change in complexion is required.

voice.pitch_register: Use a relaxed middle or low register rather than compulsory growling.
voice.pitch_range_contour: A small rising echo can be followed by a final downward dismissal.
voice.loudness: Quiet can deny the target the importance implied by a louder response.
voice.tempo_rhythm: Unhurried timing or abruptly abbreviated replies can withhold engagement.
voice.stress: Weight the pretentious word or omit expected respectful emphasis.
voice.articulation: Words can be polished, exact and conspicuously effortless.
voice.resonance: A dry, lightly resonant tone can suggest ease of judgment.
voice.texture: Tone may be cool, amused or acid without strain.
voice.breath_phrasing: Comfortable breath groups keep the apparent effort low.
voice.pauses: Pause before granting an answer or after a dismissive verdict.
voice.nonverbal_vocalizations: A short scoff or humorless chuckle is optional, never essential.

body.head_neck: Head may angle away while eyes complete the appraisal.
body.shoulders: Shoulders remain low or turn away from an attempted appeal.
body.chest_torso: Torso can withhold full orientation and equal participation.
body.arms_elbows: Arms stay economical; one small gesture can close the topic.
body.hands_fingers: Fingers may return to another task before the target finishes.
body.pelvis_weight: Weight rests comfortably rather than gathering for a fight.
body.legs_feet: Feet retain their chosen direction instead of accommodating the speaker.
body.gait: An unhurried departure can deny urgency or significance.
body.proxemics: Distance communicates exclusion; crowding is not necessary.
body.touch_props: Inspect or set aside the target’s evidence without granting it ceremonial care.
body.stillness: Stillness can make the target appear to be doing all the work of the exchange.

levels.label: Trace
levels.felt_state: A claim briefly seems less impressive than its speaker intends.
levels.face: One brow lifts while the eyes linger on the claimed achievement. A mouth corner begins to move and stops; the chin angles a fraction aside before the character returns an ordinary look.
levels.voice: Stay near habitual register with a tiny rising echo of the claim. Tone dries without losing all warmth, volume normal; delay one response, keep the phrase short, and take an easy breath as attention returns elsewhere.
levels.body: Allow the torso to stay partly on its original task. One hand pauses, then resumes sooner than full engagement would suggest; the base stays comfortable and does not reorganize around the speaker.
levels.timing: The appraisal appears after the inflated claim, not as a permanent facial decoration.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep the mouth neutral and withhold only the expected impressed nod.
levels.recovery: A more credible account can restore interest without a dramatic reversal.
levels.playable_direction: Notice the gap between the claim and its weight.

face.text: Inspect the claim before returning an otherwise ordinary social look.
Lift one brow at the mismatch between claim and substance.
Begin a small mouth-corner movement and stop it early.

voice.text: Use habitual pitch with a tiny rising echo of the claim.
Let the tone dry while retaining a little conversational warmth.
Delay one answer and resume your own pace after breathing.

body.text: Keep the torso partly assigned to its original task.
Resume the neutral hand activity sooner than full engagement would suggest.
Leave the base comfortably unchanged by the bid for recognition.

levels.label: Mild
levels.felt_state: The character begins withholding the respect being requested.
levels.face: Lower the upper lids slightly while one brow remains raised. Gaze moves from the claim to the speaker, then away; a small unilateral mouth lift ends before it becomes a broad smile.
levels.voice: Use a relaxed lower-middle register with a brief questioning rise and easy fall. Tone is cool and faintly amused at modest volume; speak unhurriedly, stress one revealing word, and leave a small pause with natural breath afterward.
levels.body: Angle the head away while the chest remains only partly engaged. Resume handling a neutral prop, keep elbows close, and let weight settle comfortably rather than preparing to debate or approach.
levels.timing: Withhold the response at the exact moment the target expects admiration or deference.
levels.restrained_alternative: Offer a formally correct answer with none of the usual acknowledgment or follow-up.
levels.recovery: Evidence of sincerity or competence can interrupt the dismissive appraisal.
levels.playable_direction: Let them feel that the performance did not earn its audience.

face.text: Look from the claim to the speaker, then disengage early.
Keep one brow raised while assessing the requested respect.
Let one mouth corner lift briefly without forming a broad smile.

voice.text: Use relaxed lower-middle pitch with an easy questioning rise and fall.
Choose cool faint amusement at a modest conversational volume.
Speak unhurriedly and leave a small, comfortably breathed aftermath.

body.text: Keep the chest only partly engaged with the speaker's appeal.
Return the hands to a neutral prop rather than argumentative gestures.
Settle weight comfortably instead of gathering for a confrontation.

levels.label: Clear
levels.felt_state: A settled devaluation shapes the exchange.
levels.face: Hold an assessing gaze beneath a lifted brow, then release it before the other person finishes. One cheek rises with a slight mouth asymmetry; the jaw stays loose, preserving an impression of low effort.
levels.voice: Keep a low or ordinary register and a precise falling verdict. Tone is dry, controlled and lightly cutting, volume conversational; slow the key comparison, abbreviate the explanation, and pause comfortably rather than rushing to justify the judgment.
levels.body: Turn the torso only enough to deliver the verdict. One small hand gesture sets the claim aside, then the arms return to rest; feet and pelvis continue claiming the character’s original direction.
levels.timing: The dismissive beat ends the topic from the character’s perspective, even if the target keeps speaking.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use an even factual sentence and return to the task without a smirk.
levels.recovery: An unexpected competent action can arrest the disengagement and bring the eyes back.
levels.playable_direction: Refuse to grant the claim the status it assumes.

face.text: Release the assessing gaze before the other person finishes speaking.
Hold a lifted brow while withholding the expected serious reception.
Use slight mouth asymmetry while keeping the jaw comfortably loose.

voice.text: Keep low or ordinary pitch and deliver a precise falling verdict.
Use a dry controlled tone with a lightly cutting conversational edge.
Slow the comparison and pause without hurrying to justify it.

body.text: Turn only enough to deliver the dismissive conclusion clearly.
Set the claim aside with one economical hand gesture.
Keep the base aligned with your original direction or task.

levels.label: Strong
levels.felt_state: The target’s persistence invites a sharper puncturing response.
levels.face: A brief eye widening at the renewed claim resolves into lowered lids. The mouth corner lifts, then flattens for exact words; the chin tips aside as the gaze assesses a weak point in the performance.
levels.voice: Begin with a small higher echo, then descend into an effortless-sounding middle register. Tone becomes acid or coolly amused at controlled volume; stretch the revealing word, cut the next phrase short, and allow a silent, easily breathed aftermath.
levels.body: Lean back into support or shift weight away. Open one hand as if displaying the claim’s inadequacy, then close the gesture; the torso remains unhurried while the other person works to regain engagement.
levels.timing: Time the sharper response to a fresh bid for recognition or authority.
levels.restrained_alternative: State the discrepancy without humor and let the absence of further engagement do the cutting.
levels.recovery: A genuine correction may reduce the attack, though esteem may not return at once.
levels.playable_direction: Puncture the claim with the least expenditure possible.

face.text: Appraise the weak point after a brief widening of the eyes.
Let the brow register the renewed claim before settling again.
Lift one mouth corner, then flatten it for exact words.

voice.text: Echo briefly at higher pitch before descending into effortless-sounding speech.
Use acid or cool amusement without adding unnecessary vocal pressure.
Stretch the revealing word, then leave an easily breathed silence.

body.text: Lean back into support while the other person seeks recognition.
Open one hand as if displaying the claim's inadequate substance.
Shift weight away without giving the exchange more urgency.

levels.label: Intense
levels.felt_state: Devaluation extends from the claim to the person’s standing.
levels.face: Look at the person for an extra beat, then deliberately disengage the eyes. The brow stays faintly raised, cheeks barely animate, and lips form a small closed line that denies both warmth and open debate.
levels.voice: Use a narrow, low register with final downward endings. Tone is cold or faintly amused, volume quiet to moderate; pace stays measured, articulation becomes clean, and long pauses with ordinary breaths imply little need to defend the verdict.
levels.body: Withdraw full bodily orientation. Return hands to a separate activity, let elbows define personal space, and settle the pelvis away from the appeal; feet do not follow attempts to reopen the exchange.
levels.timing: The target receives less response as their bid for recognition grows larger.
levels.restrained_alternative: Maintain perfect manners while removing all optional recognition, eye contact and explanation.
levels.recovery: A credible act may reopen attention before any willingness to grant respect.
levels.playable_direction: Stop treating their claim as a claim between equals.

face.text: Look an extra beat, then deliberately withdraw your visual investment.
Keep the brow faintly raised without repeated dramatic reactions.
Form a small closed line that offers neither warmth nor debate.

voice.text: Use narrow lower pitch with clearly final downward endings.
Keep the tone cold or faintly amused at controlled volume.
Measure each phrase and leave comfortable pauses after the verdict.

body.text: Withdraw full torso orientation from the repeated personal appeal.
Return the hands to a separate, purposeful practical activity.
Settle the pelvis away from attempts to reopen engagement.

levels.label: Consuming
levels.felt_state: The target is excluded from serious consideration despite pressure to engage.
levels.face: The gaze can pass over the person to someone judged worth addressing. Lids remain low, the mouth loses even the small amused lift, and the head turns with minimal acknowledgment of the excluded speaker.
levels.voice: Keep an ordinary or low register with flat, conclusive contours. Tone is impersonal and dry at chosen volume; replies shrink to essentials, pace is unhurried, and long pauses plus comfortable breaths make non-engagement the main vocal act.
levels.body: Orient the chest toward another task or participant. Hands continue a practical action, weight stays settled, and a small chair or foot adjustment removes the target from the body’s primary conversational field.
levels.timing: Let the exclusion become clear through repeated failed attempts to receive a direct response.
levels.restrained_alternative: Address necessary facts to the target formally while refusing personal or emotional engagement.
levels.recovery: Recognition of mistaken judgment can produce an awkward return of gaze and slower reconsideration.
levels.playable_direction: Deny the premise that this deserves your continued investment.

face.text: Look past the speaker toward the person you choose to address.
Let the brow remain composed while attention excludes the target.
Remove the small amused lift and keep the mouth impersonal.

voice.text: Use ordinary or low pitch with flat, conclusive sentence shapes.
Make the tone impersonal and dry at the chosen volume.
Shrink replies to essentials with unhurried, comfortably breathed gaps.

body.text: Orient the chest toward another task or available participant.
Continue a practical hand action rather than staging further dismissal.
Adjust the seated or standing base to reduce conversational inclusion.

levels.label: Overwhelming
levels.felt_state: The devaluing stance becomes total enough to erase ordinary reciprocal engagement.
levels.face: Use a nearly blank face with a final appraising look. Brows may relax rather than deepen; lips barely move, and the chin turns away after the eyes decide there is nothing further worth examining.
levels.voice: One low, exact sentence or silence can carry the peak. Tone is emptied of relational invitation, volume may be soft; keep contour narrow, pace sparse, and pauses fully occupied by ordinary breathing rather than compulsory sneering or vocal force.
levels.body: Leave, turn away, or remain seated without offering the expected response. Arms settle, hands release the shared object, and the entire base commits to nonparticipation; the absence of pursuit makes the exclusion consequential.
levels.timing: The apex can be a final withdrawal after the target’s most urgent appeal.
levels.restrained_alternative: Remain professionally functional while eliminating every optional sign of regard.
levels.recovery: Reconsideration needs a changed appraisal; time alone does not necessarily restore respect.
levels.playable_direction: Make the refusal of recognition complete.

face.text: Give one final appraisal before letting the eyes disengage completely.
Allow the brow to relax when further examination seems pointless.
Move the lips minimally around the final necessary sentence.

voice.text: Use a low exact register with very little pitch movement.
Empty the tone of invitation while keeping the sound easy.
Use sparse words and fully occupied silences with ordinary breathing.

body.text: Turn away or remain seated without supplying reciprocal engagement.
Release the shared object and let the hands settle.
Commit the whole base to a clearly chosen nonparticipation.

variants.label: Puncturing pretension
variants.context: The target claims authority, sophistication or achievement the character judges unearned.
variants.objective: Expose the mismatch and refuse automatic deference.
variants.face_modifier: Appraise the status cue itself before appraising the person using it.
variants.voice_modifier: Echo one inflated word with a small contour shift rather than generic sarcasm throughout.
variants.body_modifier: Keep the body at ease while the target performs for recognition.
variants.timing_modifier: Time dismissals to bids for status.

seven_levels.modifier: Withhold the impressed response for one beat while checking the evidence beneath the claim.
Echo a grand term lightly, then ask a plain question that tests what it means.
Name the discrepancy with a loose jaw and an economical falling cadence.
Let the target’s doubled claim meet an even shorter reply and a return to your own task.
Direct a serious question to the competent person nearby, making the claimed hierarchy fail in practice.
Stop debating the title or image and deal only with verifiable actions, visibly denying ceremonial deference.
End the audience relationship altogether; a quiet turn away can carry more complete contempt than a final insult.

variants.label: Moral devaluation
variants.context: Repeated conduct makes the character judge the target unworthy of respect.
variants.objective: Refuse endorsement or intimate standing without necessarily seeking reform.
variants.face_modifier: Remove amused asymmetry if the appraisal is grave; let a cold look and disengagement carry it.
variants.voice_modifier: Use severe, spare wording rather than mandatory wit or mockery.
variants.body_modifier: Withdraw acknowledgment, affiliation or a shared gesture as the context permits.
variants.timing_modifier: Let the final devaluation follow evidence that reform or accountability is being refused.

seven_levels.modifier: Notice the conduct and let the expected gesture of respect pause before it is offered.
Ask one testing question; an evasive answer lets the mouth lose its remaining warmth.
State what the action reveals to you and withhold the customary reassuring response.
After another evasion, stop trying to improve the person’s account and begin ending the exchange.
Refuse a shared gesture or endorsement, keeping the body formal rather than theatrically disgusted.
Handle necessary business with impersonal exactness while offering no restoration of personal regard.
Remove the target from trusted or intimate standing in the scene; the peak may contain no ridicule at all.

temporal_arc.onset: A claim or action is judged to fall below a standard of respect.
temporal_arc.escalation: Repeated evidence reduces the perceived value of engagement.
temporal_arc.apex: Dismissal, exclusion or withdrawal makes the devaluation behaviorally clear.
temporal_arc.recovery: Reappraisal, credible conduct or humility can reopen attention before respect returns.
temporal_arc.carryover: The target may continue to receive less benefit of the doubt in later encounters.

transitions.trigger: The dismissed target acquires power to cause immediate harm.
transitions.bridge: Bring the gaze and torso back; a distant verdict becomes a direct demand to stop.

transitions.trigger: Unexpected competence or integrity overturns the appraisal.
transitions.bridge: Arrest the turn away, let the brow release, and grant a second, genuinely attentive look.

transitions.trigger: The character sees that their contempt was unfair or cruel.
transitions.bridge: The assessing gaze turns inward or drops to the consequence; effortless speech loses its certainty.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Keep the torso on another task, give one assessing look, and let the expected welcoming nod fail to appear.
prompt_example.delivery_direction: Speak quietly and unhurriedly; let a small rising echo on “thought” end in a dry, final “here.”

cue_conflicts: A unilateral mouth lift is one option, not a universal identifying sign.
Amused contempt and grave moral devaluation require different tone choices.
Relaxed posture can signal low investment; it does not mean the underlying stance is weak.
emotions.context_notes: Calibrate deference, politeness and gaze to the specific relationship and cultural setting. The character’s ranking is a subjective appraisal. Limited movement can express exclusion through conversational orientation, response timing or an omitted acknowledgment.

emotions.label: Hate
emotions.definition: A sustained hostile orientation toward a target construed as fundamentally harmful or intolerable, involving a wish for separation, exclusion or opposition rather than only correction of one act.
emotions.appraisal: This target itself threatens what matters to me; a single apology or changed moment does not settle it.
emotions.objective: Exclude the target from valued life, prevent its influence or maintain opposition to it.
action_tendencies: Interpret new acts through established hostility
Protect valued people or commitments from contact
distinctions: Anger can be satisfied by correcting a specific act; hate targets the source more globally.
Rage is an acute consuming surge, while hate can be cool and enduring.
Loathing emphasizes profound aversion; hate can organize active opposition even without felt contamination.

face.brows_forehead: Brows can fix in a low line or remain composed around hostile attention.
face.eyelids: Lids firm when the target appears, without mandatory glaring.
face.gaze: Track the target selectively or deny them eye contact altogether.
face.blink: Blinking may pause during a cold appraisal and resume on disengagement.
face.cheeks: Cheeks may tense beneath an otherwise socially controlled face.
face.nose_nostrils: No compulsory nose wrinkle; aversion may be present or absent.
face.lips_mouth: Lips can lose warmth, compress or form unusually exact speech.
face.jaw_chin: Jaw resets at the target’s name; chin may align firmly away.
face.head_neck: Head orientation can refuse acknowledgment before the torso follows.
face.complexion: Any color shift is optional and context dependent.

voice.pitch_register: A settled lower register or an ordinary social register can both carry hostility.
voice.pitch_range_contour: Contours may become narrow and final when naming the target.
voice.loudness: Quiet exclusion and overt condemnation are separate available displays.
voice.tempo_rhythm: Speech can be economical, deliberate and resistant to conciliatory detours.
voice.stress: Stress boundaries, names or categorical judgments according to the scene.
voice.articulation: Exact diction can keep personal hostility hidden beneath practical language.
voice.resonance: A dry or hollowed relational resonance can contrast with warmth toward others.
voice.texture: Tone may be cold, bitter or intensely controlled without strain.
voice.breath_phrasing: Use comfortable complete phrases; hostility does not require breathless urgency.
voice.pauses: Pause before granting the target even a minimal response.
voice.nonverbal_vocalizations: A dismissive exhale may occur, but no growl or snarl is required.

body.head_neck: Head can orient toward the threat or refuse the expected greeting.
body.shoulders: Shoulders organize around distance rather than obligatory attack readiness.
body.chest_torso: Torso blocks affiliation by turning away or faces the target for a bounded confrontation.
body.arms_elbows: Arms can remain close during deliberate nonparticipation.
body.hands_fingers: Hands withhold familiar contact and manage necessary exchanges impersonally.
body.pelvis_weight: Weight locates the body near an exit, ally or protected object.
body.legs_feet: Feet establish the desired boundary and avoid accidental approach.
body.gait: A purposeful departure or direct route around the target can express exclusion.
body.proxemics: Create durable distance or a clearly chosen formal encounter.
body.touch_props: Use separate objects or set down an offered token without ritualized contamination cues.
body.stillness: Impassive stillness can communicate that the hostility is already decided.

levels.label: Trace
levels.felt_state: A faint but established hostility colors the target’s presence.
levels.face: The eyes register the target and move away sooner than they do for others. A small lip press interrupts the resting mouth; the brow remains mostly ordinary and the chin subtly declines acknowledgment.
levels.voice: Use the usual register with reduced contour on the target’s name. Tone loses warmth at normal volume; give a short practical reply, delay any optional follow-up, and take an easy breath as attention returns to someone else.
levels.body: Omit the customary welcoming movement. Keep the chest on the existing activity, hands occupied with a neutral task, and base unchanged; the target receives less bodily accommodation than other people in the scene.
levels.timing: Show contrast with the character’s treatment of someone they do not hate.
levels.restrained_alternative: Offer correct manners while leaving out one usual sign of personal recognition.
levels.recovery: The immediate reminder passes; the underlying hostile orientation need not change.
levels.playable_direction: Keep them outside the circle without making a scene.

face.text: Register the target and look away sooner than with others.
Keep the brow mostly ordinary around the selective hostile attention.
Interrupt the resting mouth with one small unwelcoming lip press.

voice.text: Use ordinary pitch with reduced contour on the target's name.
Remove warmth while preserving normal conversational volume and vocal ease.
Give a short practical reply, then pause without optional follow-up.

body.text: Keep the chest on the activity that already mattered.
Omit the customary welcoming movement and keep the hands occupied.
Leave the base unchanged instead of accommodating the target's arrival.

levels.label: Mild
levels.felt_state: The character actively limits contact with the disliked target.
levels.face: Hold the lower lids firm during a brief appraisal, then let gaze return to the chosen ally or task. The mouth stays neutral rather than smiling; the jaw shifts once at the target’s approach.
levels.voice: Stay in a controlled middle or low register with compact falling endings. Tone is cool at conversational volume; slow the boundary word, keep the rest efficient, and use a small pause with natural breath before necessary business.
levels.body: Angle the torso to preserve a margin of space. Keep arms close, decline an optional handoff or greeting, and shift weight toward the route that avoids extending the encounter.
levels.timing: Contact ends as soon as the necessary exchange is complete.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use an ordinary friendly surface while keeping all practical interaction brief and bounded.
levels.recovery: Distance reduces immediate activation without resolving the underlying hostility.
levels.playable_direction: Give them access to the task, not to you.

face.text: Appraise the target briefly before returning to an ally or task.
Let the brow stay controlled above firmer, less welcoming eyes.
Hold the mouth neutral instead of supplying the expected smile.

voice.text: Use controlled middle or lower pitch with compact falling endings.
Keep the tone cool at an ordinary conversational volume.
Slow the boundary word and breathe before necessary business resumes.

body.text: Angle the torso to preserve a deliberate margin of space.
Decline the optional handoff or familiar greeting without extra gestures.
Shift weight toward the route that keeps the encounter brief.

levels.label: Clear
levels.felt_state: The target is clearly appraised as an enduring source of harm.
levels.face: Look directly long enough to make recognition unmistakable, then withhold warmth. Brows settle, lips form a firm line between exact words, and the chin stays level as the character refuses the expected reconciliation cue.
levels.voice: Use a grounded register and final downward contours on conditions. Tone is cold or bitter at modest volume; speak deliberately, stress the enduring boundary, and leave a clean pause with an ordinary breath after the target proposes closeness.
levels.body: Face the exchange only for its practical purpose. Keep hands apart from any offered touch, settle the pelvis into a stable base, and maintain a clear path out rather than drifting toward the appeal.
levels.timing: A conciliatory gesture fails to produce the response the target expects.
levels.restrained_alternative: State a factual condition for contact with no overt insult or hostile display.
levels.recovery: End the encounter on clear terms; warmer feeling may remain unavailable.
levels.playable_direction: Make the distance something they cannot mistake for temporary mood.

face.text: Look directly long enough to make recognition clear, then withhold warmth.
Settle the brows around an already established hostile appraisal.
Keep a firm mouth line between exact practical statements.

voice.text: Use grounded pitch and final falls on conditions for contact.
Let the tone remain cold or bitter at modest volume.
Speak deliberately and pause through any appeal for easy closeness.

body.text: Face the person only for the exchange's bounded practical purpose.
Keep the hands separate from an offered familiar touch.
Settle the base with a clear, available route out.

levels.label: Strong
levels.felt_state: New contact confirms the hostile interpretation and invites explicit opposition.
levels.face: Gaze follows the target’s relevant action beneath a firmer brow. The mouth opens quickly to oppose it, then closes into a controlled line; cheek tension remains after the character turns toward someone they trust.
levels.voice: A sharper upper-register interruption can settle into a low, precise statement. Tone is severe but easy to produce, volume firm; accelerate the immediate objection, slow the lasting judgment, then pause and breathe before outlining the limit.
levels.body: Move to protect a boundary, resource or ally without compulsory physical shielding. The torso becomes decisive, one hand marks the limit, and feet or seated weight establish a position from which access can be refused.
levels.timing: Tie the renewed intensity to a concrete action, not a generalized menacing entrance.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use procedural authority or exact logistics to oppose the target while keeping the face composed.
levels.recovery: Removal of access restores function, though attention may keep checking the boundary.
levels.playable_direction: Stop their influence from entering what you are protecting.

face.text: Follow the target's relevant action with a selective, direct gaze.
Firm the brow when present behavior confirms the hostile interpretation.
Open quickly to object, then return to a controlled line.

voice.text: Let a sharper interruption settle into a low precise statement.
Use a severe, easily produced tone at appropriately firm volume.
Quicken the immediate stop, then slow the enduring boundary.

body.text: Orient the torso toward the actual resource or boundary being protected.
Mark the limit with one hand rather than unnecessary menace.
Establish a base from which access can be clearly refused.

levels.label: Intense
