levels.body: Allow the torso to rest fully in its support while arms and hands stay available for simple use. Weight no longer hovers toward the next task; a gentle head turn or small prop movement is enough to remain connected to the scene.
levels.timing: Unfilled intervals become part of the pleasure rather than gaps to repair.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep the smile absent while maintaining easy, responsive eye contact.
levels.recovery: Shift into necessary action at the same unforced pace.
levels.playable_direction: Let the room offer enough without searching for the next reward.

levels.label: Strong
levels.felt_state: A meaningful sense of sufficiency makes competing improvements temporarily irrelevant.
levels.face: Hold an easy look at the person or place that feels enough. A smile can spread briefly and then rest; cheeks release, lower lids stay soft and the forehead remains open, with no obligation to close the eyes or tip back the head.
levels.voice: Choose a grounded habitual register, gentle resolving contours and a full but quiet warmth. Volume remains modest. Slow the transitions between thoughts, not every syllable; allow easy breaths and substantial companionable pauses, articulating plainly when there is actually something to say.
levels.body: Let a hand stop halfway toward an unnecessary adjustment and return to rest. The pelvis accepts support, shoulders release their readiness and the chest stays comfortably upright; the character remains capable of action while electing not to improve the moment.
levels.timing: An impulse to optimize appears, then is consciously allowed to pass.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use a steady face and one deliberate decision to leave something alone.
levels.recovery: Carry the sufficiency into the next task rather than defending the pause.
levels.playable_direction: Choose to stay with this instead of making it better.

levels.label: Intense
levels.felt_state: The felt completeness is deep enough to quiet persistent striving.

Use fewer, complete phrases at an unhurried pace; leave generous silences and natural breathing space, allowing presence to carry what description cannot improve.
levels.body: Release the last repeated checking gesture and let the hands rest openly or loosely together. The torso is well supported, head remains responsive and weight stays settled; strong contentment may look less animated than mild pleasure because reaching has ceased.
levels.timing: Hold the lack of urgency long enough for it to become meaningful.
levels.restrained_alternative: Maintain ordinary posture while declining the impulse to rush into another task.
levels.recovery: Acknowledge an interruption without treating it as a threat to the ease.
levels.playable_direction: Let yourself need nothing additional from this exact moment.

levels.label: Consuming
levels.felt_state: Sufficiency fills attention so completely that habitual comparison loses its force.
levels.face: The face can become very simple: steady soft gaze, easy brow and gently closed lips. A brief smile may appear at recognition and fade naturally; blinking remains ordinary, and the chin rests without the withdrawal or droop of disengagement.

levels.body: Stay with stable support and minimal movement. Arms rest, fingers cease searching for occupation and the torso follows ordinary breathing; a small turn toward a companion confirms relational availability while the lower body can remain entirely still.
levels.timing: The sustained beat is the absence of an internal next demand.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep the eyes attentive and let the full feeling remain almost invisible.
levels.recovery: Reenter activity through a chosen necessity rather than restless self-interruption.
levels.playable_direction: Allow comparison to fall silent while you remain fully present.

levels.label: Overwhelming
levels.felt_state: The sense of enough exceeds ordinary description without becoming stimulation or excitement.
levels.face: Let the gaze receive the scene with unusual steadiness. The mouth may soften into a small smile and release again; brows and jaw rest, and the eyes remain clear enough to meet another person when addressed, without a blissful mask.
levels.voice: Words may be unnecessary. If speaking, use the familiar comfortable register, a simple rounded contour and an unforced, deeply settled tone. Keep loudness ordinary or quiet, phrases sparse and pace responsive; allow ample pauses and natural breaths without theatrical breathiness or induced breath holding.
levels.body: Let the body be securely supported and available. Hands rest without gripping, torso remains comfortably organized and head turns only for meaningful contact. Intensity resides in profound sufficiency; no increased gesture, widened stance, collapse or visible lower-body action is needed.
levels.timing: The apex is a sustained, lucid settling rather than a discharge.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use ordinary appearance and one calm refusal to manufacture another need.
levels.recovery: Return to necessary action while preserving the permission to be enough.
levels.playable_direction: Let this moment be complete before you ask anything else of it.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Let their arrival complete an already pleasant arrangement; rest the gaze on them with an easy mouth.

cue_conflicts: Deep contentment may be intensely felt with fewer visible cues than mild pleasure.
Closed eyes are optional; responsive open eyes can better distinguish presence from disengagement.
A slumped torso may indicate fatigue rather than contentment unless the scene establishes ease.
emotions.context_notes: These are editorial options for felt sufficiency. Calibrate to individual baseline, relationship, power and cultural norms around leisure or silence; use accessible support and do not equate stillness with immobility.

emotions.label: Satisfaction
emotions.definition: Pleasure in recognizing that a desired result, standard or need has been met; the feeling is organized around adequacy of outcome rather than victory over another person.
emotions.appraisal: This meets the condition I cared about, and I can acknowledge that it is done or enough.
emotions.objective: Verify the result, claim its adequacy and permit the effort to resolve.
distinctions: Triumph foregrounds overcoming opposition; satisfaction can follow quiet adequacy.
Pride evaluates the self; satisfaction can focus entirely on the result.
Contentment need not refer to a completed aim or standard.

face.brows_forehead: Brow concentration releases after the result passes inspection.
face.eyelids: Lids may narrow to verify, then soften in acknowledgment.
face.gaze: Look at the result before seeking approval from a witness.

voice.pitch_range_contour: Contours may descend with clear completion rather than hopeful upward checking.
voice.loudness: Volume matches the acknowledgment’s audience without demanding a declaration.
voice.tempo_rhythm: Pace becomes measured as the task resolves.
voice.stress: Stress the completed condition or exact feature that works.
voice.articulation: Articulation can be clean and decisive without clipped aggression.
voice.resonance: Use grounded, comfortable resonance.
voice.texture: Tone may be dryly pleased, warm or quietly firm.
voice.breath_phrasing: Let a natural exhale mark released effort before the conclusion.
voice.pauses: Pause for verification, then stop after the acknowledgment.
voice.nonverbal_vocalizations: A small hum, pleased exhale or brief chuckle may replace praise.

body.proxemics: Distance may widen to assess the result rather than indicate rejection.
body.touch_props: Set down the relevant prop with finality instead of repeatedly rechecking it.
