transitions.bridge: Let the next gaze stay longer and a genuine follow-up question gain personal investment.

transitions.trigger: An unexpected event interrupts the current model of the scene.
transitions.bridge: Interrupt the ordinary action at the actual new information, then orient toward its source.

transitions.trigger: A welcome event gains clear personal meaning.
transitions.bridge: Let recognition change the mouth and contour before a chosen approach or sharing gesture follows.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Look from the ordinary task to the listener with your usual resting face; let the words follow accurate recognition of their presence.
prompt_example.delivery_direction: Use your normal speaking register, natural sentence contour and practical emphasis on the location; leave an ordinary turn-taking pause afterward.

cue_conflicts: Neutral does not mean expressionless, monotonous, slow, calm or emotionally inaccessible.
A habitual smile, concentrated brow or naturally rough voice may belong to baseline rather than signal a foreground emotion.
Higher levels mean stronger baseline predominance; the fixed label “Overwhelming” is an interface label, not a felt neutral crisis.
emotions.context_notes: Establish this individual’s ordinary expression, voice, movement and access needs before using neutral as a reference. Relationship, culture, role and power shape customary courtesy and distance. Preserve mobility, habitual asymmetry and genuine responsiveness; do not standardize neutrality around one body, identity or temperament.

emotions.label: Determination
emotions.definition: A goal-directed commitment to continue or act despite difficulty, uncertainty or competing impulses; it can organize many emotions and is not itself a guarantee that the chosen goal is wise.
emotions.appraisal: This matters enough that I will choose and sustain the next workable action.
emotions.objective: Commit attention and effort to a bounded goal while adapting the method to reality.
action_tendencies: Revise the method while preserving the goal
distinctions: Frustration emphasizes blocked effort; determination organizes a chosen response to the block.
Anger opposes a breach; determination can pursue a goal without blame or hostility.
Hope imagines a valued possibility; determination commits behavior even when confidence is limited.

face.brows_forehead: Brows can gather in focus and release when the next step becomes clear.
face.eyelids: Lids firm around the task without obligatory squinting.
face.gaze: Fix on the next relevant cue, then scan deliberately for needed information.
face.blink: Blinking remains ordinary or pauses briefly during a decision.
face.cheeks: Cheeks stay neutral or firm with concentration.
face.nose_nostrils: Nose remains ordinary; avoid compulsory flaring as a strength cue.
face.lips_mouth: Lips close on a decision, then open for concise instructions.
face.jaw_chin: Jaw settles and releases; chin aligns toward the chosen task.
face.head_neck: Head becomes steady without rigid locking.
face.complexion: No particular flush or pallor is required.

voice.pitch_register: A settled register can replace uncertainty, whether naturally high or low.
voice.pitch_range_contour: Contours become complete and purposeful, with rises for real questions.
voice.loudness: Volume serves the audience and task rather than proving commitment.
voice.tempo_rhythm: Pace is deliberate, with enough time to act and reassess.
voice.stress: Stress the next action, limit or commitment.
voice.articulation: Clear articulation can make instructions and decisions usable.
voice.resonance: A present, supported sound can remain calm under pressure.
voice.texture: Tone may be steady, grave, energized or quietly insistent.
voice.breath_phrasing: Use sustainable breath groups and comfortable resets between action units.
voice.pauses: Pauses can be decisions or checks, not hesitation by default.
voice.nonverbal_vocalizations: A preparatory exhale or brief affirmative sound is optional.

body.head_neck: Head aligns with the next relevant target.
body.shoulders: Shoulders organize for the task and release unnecessary bracing.
body.chest_torso: Torso orients toward useful action rather than performing generic toughness.
body.arms_elbows: Arms select a workable position for the actual activity.
body.hands_fingers: Hands prepare the tool, steady the object or open for a chosen contact.
body.pelvis_weight: Weight settles into a sustainable base.
body.legs_feet: Feet choose a route or brace safely for the specific task.
body.gait: Movement has a destination and adjusts to obstacles.
body.proxemics: Distance serves the goal, respecting other people’s boundaries.
body.touch_props: Handle tools and props deliberately, with attention to what they actually require.
body.stillness: Stillness can be a decision held through pressure before the next action.

levels.label: Trace
levels.felt_state: A small preference becomes a deliberate intention.
levels.face: Gaze settles on the next step and the brow lightly gathers. Lips close for a beat, the chin aligns with the task, and the eyes return from distraction with a more settled focus.
levels.voice: Use habitual register with a clearer falling finish. Tone becomes quietly purposeful at normal volume; slow the action word, remove one filler phrase, and take an easy breath after a short decision pause before beginning.
levels.body: Stop the unrelated hand movement and place the tool where it is needed. Turn the torso slightly toward the task, settle weight, and let feet or seated base choose a useful orientation.
levels.timing: The decision becomes visible through one changed practical action.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep the face relaxed and simply start the chosen step without announcing resolve.
levels.recovery: Completion allows attention to broaden without requiring a celebratory release.
levels.playable_direction: Choose the next small thing and do it.

face.text: Settle the eyes on the next step after leaving the distraction.
Gather the brow lightly around a newly chosen intention.
Close the lips briefly before opening for the practical decision.

voice.text: Use habitual pitch with a clearer, more complete falling finish.
Make the tone quietly purposeful at ordinary conversational volume.
Slow the action word and breathe after the decision pause.

body.text: Turn the torso toward the task that now receives priority.
Stop the unrelated hand movement and prepare the useful tool.
Settle weight into a base that supports the first step.

levels.label: Mild
levels.felt_state: The goal merits sustained attention despite minor friction.
levels.face: Eyes return to the task after a brief check of the obstacle. Brows knit in focus, mouth forms a small settled line, and the head stays steady as the character chooses a workable adjustment.
levels.voice: Use a comfortable settled register with complete, modest contours. Tone is steady at conversational volume; speak at an even pace, stress the next action, and leave a brief checking pause with ordinary breath before continuing the plan.
levels.body: Reposition the tool or body for a more sustainable attempt. Elbows find support, hands prepare deliberately, and torso and base align with the route that makes continued effort possible rather than merely looking forceful.
levels.timing: Minor distraction is noticed and dismissed through a practical return.
levels.restrained_alternative: Use ordinary conversational warmth while the hands continue a clearly chosen sequence.
levels.recovery: A finished unit of work permits a brief rest without abandoning the commitment.
levels.playable_direction: Keep giving the goal the attention it actually needs.

face.text: Return the eyes to the task after checking the small obstacle.
Knit the brows in focus while choosing a workable adjustment.
Form a small settled mouth line before resuming the sequence.

voice.text: Use a comfortable settled register with complete modest contours.
Keep the tone steady at an ordinary conversational volume.
Maintain an even pace with short checking pauses and ordinary breaths.

body.text: Align the torso with a sustainable approach to continued work.
Prepare the hands deliberately and remove unnecessary working tension.
Reposition the base to support effort rather than display force.

levels.label: Clear
levels.felt_state: A clear commitment holds through an identifiable obstacle.
levels.face: Fix the gaze on the relevant problem, then scan once for a usable route. Brows draw together and release slightly at the decision; lips open for a concise instruction while the chin remains level.
levels.voice: Use a grounded register and a firm falling cadence on the commitment. Tone is clear and present, volume appropriate to the listener; pace is measured, stress the concrete next step, and pause with comfortable breath before acting rather than overexplaining.
levels.body: Settle the pelvis and feet into a stable base, orient the chest toward the work, and assign both hands useful roles. Stop extraneous gestures so the chosen action reads as specific, sustainable and ready.
levels.timing: A decision pause is followed promptly by a visible next step.
levels.restrained_alternative: Remain outwardly calm and let consistent follow-through, rather than a stern face, show the commitment.
levels.recovery: Success or feedback becomes information for the next step, not a requirement for continued self-worth.
levels.playable_direction: Commit to a method you can actually begin.

face.text: Scan once for a route, then fix on the relevant problem.
Gather and release the brow as the workable decision forms.
Open the lips for a concise, usable instruction or commitment.

voice.text: Use grounded pitch and a firm falling commitment cadence.
Keep the tone clear and present at an appropriate volume.
Measure the next step and pause comfortably before acting.

body.text: Orient the chest toward the actual task rather than generic toughness.
Assign both hands useful roles and stop unrelated gestures.
Settle pelvis and feet into a stable, sustainable working base.

levels.label: Strong
levels.felt_state: The goal remains chosen after a meaningful setback or cost appears.
levels.face: Eyes hold on the failed result before shifting to the next workable option. Brows tighten briefly, lips press against a discouraged reply, and the jaw releases as the head reorients toward renewed action.
levels.voice: A momentary higher or lower reaction settles into a steady working register. Tone is grave or energized without strain, volume firm or quiet; slow the revised plan, leave a clear reset pause, and take an ordinary breath before recommitting.
levels.body: Stop the failed method, put the tool down or change grip, and reset the torso and base. Hands prepare a genuinely revised approach; feet choose a new angle rather than repeating the same frustrated movement.
levels.timing: Let the setback register before resolve reorganizes it into another action.
levels.restrained_alternative: Acknowledge the difficulty in an even voice and continue with one concrete adjustment.
levels.recovery: A usable rhythm returns when effort matches the revised method.
levels.playable_direction: Keep the goal while changing what is not working.

face.text: Look at the failed result, then choose the next workable option.
Tighten the brow briefly before allowing the revised plan to organize.
Press the lips against discouragement, then release for the new action.

voice.text: Let the reaction settle into a steady working register.
Use grave or energized tone without strain or compulsory projection.
Slow the revised plan and take an ordinary reset breath.

body.text: Stop the failed torso approach and establish a useful new angle.
Put the tool down or change grip before attempting again.
Reset the base so the next method differs from the failed one.

levels.label: Intense
levels.felt_state: The commitment carries a personal cost and competes with a strong urge to stop.
levels.face: Look briefly toward comfort, escape or approval, then return to the chosen task. The brow remains focused, lips tremble or press once before settling, and the chin aligns without theatrical elevation.
levels.voice: Use a narrowed, settled register with exact endings. Tone is taut in feeling but comfortably supported, volume chosen for the task; pace slows around the costly commitment, pauses separate decisions, and easy breaths preserve endurance rather than implying limitless effort.
levels.body: Let a withdrawal begin and stop through a conscious choice. Release unnecessary shoulder tension, place hands deliberately, and ground the base; the torso turns back toward one achievable step instead of a vague heroic push.
levels.timing: The cost becomes visible immediately before the recommitment, giving the action meaning.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep the voice soft and complete the next unit of work without announcing sacrifice.
levels.recovery: Rest, help or a bounded milestone can preserve commitment without pretending capacity is infinite.
levels.playable_direction: Choose the cost you can responsibly carry for this goal.

face.text: Look briefly toward escape or approval, then return to the goal.
Keep the brow focused while the personal cost becomes visible.
Press or tremble the lips once before the commitment settles.

voice.text: Use narrowed settled pitch with exact and complete endings.
Let the tone feel taut while remaining comfortably supported.
Slow the costly commitment and separate decisions with ordinary breaths.

body.text: Stop a withdrawal and turn the torso toward one achievable step.
Release unnecessary hand tension and prepare the actual action.
Ground the base instead of making a vague heroic push.

levels.label: Consuming
levels.felt_state: The goal dominates attention and requires active regulation to remain workable.
levels.face: Gaze narrows to the next relevant cue, then deliberately checks the wider situation. Brows stay gathered, mouth moves only for necessary instructions, and a purposeful blink accompanies releasing fixation before choosing the next action.
levels.voice: Keep a stable register with sparse, complete contours. Tone is concentrated and plain at quiet or firm volume; use short action units, deliberate pace, genuine reassessment pauses and comfortable breath resets so persistence remains adaptable rather than mechanically relentless.
levels.body: Organize the body around an efficient sequence. Hands stop unnecessary force, arms use available support, and torso and base reset between efforts; choose a brief rest or delegated step when it protects the larger objective.
levels.timing: After each unit, include a check that can genuinely change the method.
levels.restrained_alternative: Maintain nearly expressionless calm while every movement remains assigned to the goal.
levels.recovery: A milestone or external cue helps attention broaden; fatigue and other feelings may emerge afterward.
levels.playable_direction: Persist without letting tunnel vision choose the method.

face.text: Narrow onto the task, then deliberately check the wider situation.
Keep the brow gathered while allowing feedback to change the method.
Move the lips only for necessary instructions and real questions.

voice.text: Use stable pitch with sparse, complete and purposeful contours.
Choose concentrated plain tone at quiet or firm comfortable volume.
Use short action units, genuine checking pauses and easy breath resets.

body.text: Organize the torso efficiently and reset between sustained efforts.
Stop unnecessary force and use the support the task permits.
Reestablish the base or rest briefly when that preserves the goal.

levels.label: Overwhelming
levels.felt_state: Commitment fills experience and holds despite profound competing emotion or uncertainty.
levels.face: A still, level gaze can replace any hardened mask. Brows remain lightly focused, lips part for one final decision, and the jaw releases before the eyes choose the immediate task; no glare or unbroken stare is required.
levels.voice: One low or ordinary-register sentence can carry overwhelming resolve. Tone is steady or momentarily fragile without strain, volume optional; use a complete contour, sparse pace, long decision pauses and natural breathing before action, rest or a principled change of course.
levels.body: Become still long enough to choose the next bounded act. Set hands where they can work, find stable support through torso and base, and move with purpose; refusing an impossible method can express commitment as strongly as advancing.
levels.timing: The peak is a chosen commitment held through the strongest pressure to abandon or distort it.
levels.restrained_alternative: Keep an ordinary face and voice while taking the one consequential step the character has decided on.
levels.recovery: Broaden attention after the decisive act; reassess the goal, capacity and consequences rather than requiring endless endurance.
levels.playable_direction: Do the next right step for this goal, with your eyes open to its cost.

face.text: Hold a level gaze, then choose the immediate relevant task.
Maintain light focused brow activity without adopting a hardened mask.
Part the lips for one final, bounded and deliberate decision.

voice.text: Use low or ordinary pitch with a clearly completed contour.
Keep the tone steady or briefly fragile without strain.
Use sparse pace, long decision pauses and natural available breathing.

body.text: Become still long enough to choose the next bounded act.
Place the hands where the chosen action can actually begin.
Find stable support before advancing, refusing or changing the method.

variants.label: Sustained task commitment
variants.context: A difficult practical goal requires repeated effort, adaptation and endurance.
variants.objective: Complete a bounded task through workable, revisable steps.
variants.face_modifier: Focus on feedback that can change the method, not on a generic distant stare.
variants.voice_modifier: Use clear task language with pauses for actual checks.
variants.body_modifier: Choose efficient accessible mechanics and sustainable resets.
variants.timing_modifier: Build resolve through decision, attempt, feedback and adjustment.

seven_levels.modifier: Clear one distraction and begin the next small step without needing an inspirational declaration.
Notice a minor obstacle, adjust the setup, and preserve an even working rhythm.
State the immediate target and give each hand or available action a useful role.
After failure, let disappointment register before selecting a materially different method.
Accept a defined cost while using rest, help or pacing to keep the effort sustainable.
Check the wider situation between action units so persistence does not become blind repetition.
Choose the decisive bounded act, or reject an impossible method while preserving the meaningful goal; commitment need not mean limitless exertion.

variants.label: Principled commitment
variants.context: The character resolves to uphold a value or fulfill an obligation despite pressure.
variants.objective: Make the value concrete through a chosen action or refusal.
variants.face_modifier: Let eyes acknowledge the cost or opposing person before settling on the commitment.
variants.voice_modifier: Finish the commitment clearly without requiring a moralizing speech.
variants.body_modifier: Use a signature, refusal, presence or practical step that makes the value consequential.
variants.timing_modifier: Place the costly choice before the action that embodies it.

seven_levels.modifier: Notice the small choice that would compromise the value and select a clear alternative.
State the preference calmly and follow it through when convenience suggests abandoning it.
Make the obligation or boundary explicit, then take one action that gives it practical force.
After pressure increases, acknowledge what compliance would buy and decline it deliberately.
Let the personal cost register in a pause, then choose the value without pretending the cost is trivial.
Maintain the commitment through repeated pressure while checking that the chosen method still serves the value.
Accept the consequence of one decisive act or refusal; a quiet signed page, kept promise or maintained boundary can carry the full intensity.

temporal_arc.onset: A valued goal becomes a chosen commitment rather than a passing preference.
temporal_arc.escalation: Obstacles and costs require repeated selection of workable action.
temporal_arc.apex: A decisive act, sustained course or principled refusal makes the commitment consequential.
temporal_arc.recovery: After a milestone, attention broadens and effort is reassessed against capacity and outcomes.
temporal_arc.carryover: The commitment can persist quietly between visible efforts and may strengthen or revise future choices.

transitions.trigger: A meaningful bounded goal is completed.
transitions.bridge: Let the working gaze take in the result, release the prepared hands and receive the completion.

transitions.trigger: The current method repeatedly fails to produce progress.
transitions.bridge: The steady sequence breaks into retries; gaze alternates between obstacle and unavailable route.

transitions.trigger: Sustained effort exceeds available capacity.
transitions.bridge: The next action becomes costly or unavailable; accept support or rest as attention broadens to the body’s limits.

prompt_example.spoken_text: I thought you would be here.
prompt_example.visual_direction: Pause at the obstacle, choose a workable next step, and place the hands deliberately before looking up.
prompt_example.delivery_direction: Use a settled register and a complete falling cadence; leave a decision pause, then act on the expectation.

cue_conflicts: Determination is a motivational state, not proof of anger, confidence, wisdom or moral correctness.
A hard stare and clenched body are optional displays; relaxed efficient action may be more committed.
Rest, assistance and a changed method can preserve the goal rather than negate resolve.
emotions.context_notes: Define the goal, cost and available choices concretely. Individual capacity, relationship, power and cultural commitments shape persistence. Adapt action to mobility and resources; accessible decision-making, speech or delegated work can express full determination.
